decisions.inventory: 773 actual catalogue cards in fifteen complete collector families: 487 expanded base, 2 loose checklists, 110 Chrome, 10 Classic Renditions, 15 New Age Performers, 10 Then and Now, 50 blue autographs, 51 red autographs including unnumbered Mays replacement, 3 Classic autographs, 12 single/6 dual/4 autograph Clubhouse Collection relics, 7 Grandstand Glory, 5 Time Capsule, 1 box-only AutoProof. Complete CSV executed and validated; no expected-count placeholders.
decisions.baseVariations: Base 407 subjects plus 80 additional red/black-back variants. Local A/B are not printed. Ten mid-series black-only backs and #41 Buehrle misspelling retained. High numbers 311-407 kept within same base family; range scarcity flattened under existing conventions.
decisions.rookies: Exactly 22 independently corroborated true base RCs. No Ichiro or Pujols in this product. Chrome and autograph marketing do not confer true RC suffixes.
decisions.autographs: 50 actually signed subjects per colour, not intended 52. Exclude non-signed Eddie Mathews/Larry Doby paper redemptions. Retain the actual unnumbered Mays red replacement alongside 50 /52 cards in complete red collector family, with null pack odds. Duplicate THA-ML and numbered Mays local suffixes explicitly identified as catalogue-only.
decisions.numbering: Exact TCDB catalogue identifiers preserved except TH spacing normalized and duplicate blue THA-ML Matt Lawton locally THA-ML2. Autograph relic source discrepancy resolved by original Snider THCC-DS /25 back. CBC extra A forms are catalogue aliases, not extra cards.
decisions.namesTeams: Every available full supplementary tuple checked; its 49-card blue autograph table omits duplicate-number Matt Lawton, covered by two independent complete rosters. Historical New York Giants, Brooklyn Dodgers, Boston/Milwaukee Braves, Philadelphia Athletics, Washington Senators retained. Red Joe Garagiola team corrected to Pittsburgh from explicit original back, matching blue ink; conflicting Cardinals front logo documented. Only loose checklist cards have blank teams.
decisions.packConfiguration: Original Hobby box confirms 24 packs of eight cards. Wrapper confirms eight cards plus gum; gum is not an inventory card. Retail blaster seven packs is not Hobby configuration. Pack/box MSRP conflicts across sources irrelevant to VCS pending pricing.
decisions.packOdds: ProductSet-level verified representable Hobby rates only. Mixed bat/jersey/dual families remain intact with odds null rather than arbitrary averaging or range/material splits. Red family includes non-pack replacement; AutoProof is box-only; both null. Full historical physical table preserved with its identified bat/signer count errors. No rounded, invented or box-to-pack odds.
decisions.exclusions: Three pre-production dealer/media promos PP1-PP3, generic 1952-card and replica apparel exchange tickets, and non-signed Mathews/Doby exchange promises excluded. No fabricated autograph, extra Chrome refractor, hologram, or 1952 buyback checklist. Actual signed Mays #261 buyback retained separately with null pack odds.
decisions.verificationLimit: Catalogue/metadata audit of every output row, plus selected original scans resolving pack configuration, numbering and team discrepancies; not a scan-by-scan audit of all cards. Source retrieval failures fail closed. Beckett direct retrieval 404, so its headline count was not used to pad roster; full TCDB/CBC/supplementary rosters used.
decisions.release: Unreleased Admin draft for pricing/image harvesting. Blocked pending pack/collation QA, remaining mixed-family odds, images and pricing. No production DB or deployment.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: 407 numbered subjects; 80 extra red/black-back variants give 487 rows. Local A/B suffixes are catalogue IDs, not printed. Keep all in one base family; low-number scarcity/high numbers 1:2 preserved in research; no range splitting.

productSets.name: Checklists
productSets.notes: Two separately catalogued loose checklists: #1 1-359; #2 360-407 and Inserts. Blank teams intentional. Frequency unverified, null.

productSets.name: Chrome
productSets.notes: Full 110-card partial parallel CP1-CP110, /552. Hobby/retail 1:25; no extra 407-card chrome family or refractors invented.

productSets.name: Then and Now
productSets.notes: Full ten-card TH1-TH10 dual-player checklist; Hobby 1:8, retail 1:15. TCDB spacing TH 1 normalized to TH1.

productSets.name: Autographs
productSets.notes: 50 actual signed blue-ink subjects; reported print run 200 each, NOT serial numbered. Hobby 1:142. No signed Mathews/Doby invented; their expired paper exchanges excluded. Duplicate printed THA-ML uses local THA-ML2 for Matt Lawton.

productSets.name: Autographs Red Ink
productSets.notes: 50 numbered /52 signed subjects plus one unnumbered Mays replacement =51 actual cards. Excludes unsigned Mathews exchange. THA-WMA identifies numbered Mays locally; printed THA-WM. Physical numbered-red Hobby 1:545; entire family null because replacement was not pack-issued and current engine cannot filter it within family.

productSets.name: Clubhouse Collection Relics
productSets.notes: Complete twelve-card family: ten bats, two jerseys. BCP odds table 20 bats is erroneous. Physical bat 1:590 / jersey 1:798 Hobby; null combined family pending mixed-material collation QA.

productSets.name: Clubhouse Collection Dual Relics
productSets.notes: Complete six-card /52 family, five dual bats and one dual jersey. BCP roster omits two cards; TCDB and CBC complete. Hobby bats 1:5701 / jersey 1:28744; combined-family odds null.

productSets.name: Clubhouse Collection Autograph Relics
productSets.notes: Four completed /25 autograph relic cards (three bats, one jersey). Original Snider back confirms THCC-DS, not THCC-ADS. Hobby bats 1:19710 / jersey 1:62714; combined-family odds null.

productSets.name: Grandstand Glory
productSets.notes: Complete seven stadium-seat relics; not player-used gear. Hobby/retail 1:211.

productSets.name: Time Capsule
productSets.notes: Four singles plus one Mays/Williams dual /52. Korean War-era uniform material NOT worn by featured players. Hobby singles 1:369 / dual 1:28744; combined-family odds null.

productSets.name: AutoProofs
productSets.notes: 1952 Topps Willie Mays #261 buyback autograph /25, Hobby BOX topper 1:5749 boxes. Not pack-issued; odds null, never treat boxes as packs.
